Sample.evidence_source: The initial sample was composed of 514 individuals (494 women and 20 men), with ages ranging from 17 to 57 years old. However, taking into account the purpose of the current study, data cleaning procedures excluded: (a) male participants and (b) participants younger than 18 years old and older than 55 years old.
Sample.warning: Final analytic sample size after exclusions (i.e., after removing males and out-of-range ages) is not reported; only the initial sample (514) and the exclusion criteria are provided.

section_summary.extract_value: This section describes procedures and recruitment: participants were recruited via online advertisements on social networks and provided written informed consent. The initial sample comprised 514 individuals (494 women, 20 men) aged 17–57, but the authors state they excluded male participants and those younger than 18 or older than 55; the final analytic sample size after these exclusions is not reported.
